name: SIMI B12 CYANOCOBALAMIN (VITAMIN B12) 30 CHEWABLE TABLETS
description: Vitamin B12 (Cyanocobalamin), in convenient chewable tablets, is designed to counteract vitamin B12 deficiencies: chronic weakness and fatigue, numbness in arms and legs, due to various illnesses. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
